text.body: tāṃ vidyāmiha labhemahi| yā darśayed jñānasūryam,ajñānatimirāpahā| yā dadyāt śāśvataṃ saukhyaṃ, tāṃ vidyāmiha labhemahi||1|| dainyaṃ duḥkhaṃ lopayed yā, pāpaṃ tāpaṃ ca vārayet| cittaṃ śāntaṃ ca yā kuryāt ,tāṃ vidyāmiha labhemahi||2|| mokṣakāraṇabhūtā yā, nānātve caikyadarśinī| antaḥ prasannatāṃ dadyāt, tāṃ vidyāmiha labhemahi||3|| ahaṃbhāvaṃ lopayed yā,hitaṃ viśvasya sādhayet| anāthāya karaṃ dadyāt, tāṃ vidyāmiha labhemahi||4|| dharmādipuruṣārthānāṃ yatra sārthakatā bhavet| sārthā sākṣaratā yatra, tāṃ vidyāmiha labhemahi||5|| ānandajā, tathā viśvaṃ yānandena prapūrayet| ānande yā bhavellīnā tāṃ vidyāmiha labhemahi||6||
